name: Birthday
author: PacNPal
short: Give members a birthday role until midnight and throw them a party.
description: Assign a birthday role that is removed automatically at midnight in your timezone, with randomised cake-filled announcements, custom messages, slash commands and right-click context menus.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Birthday! Set it up with `[p]birthdayset role @Role`, then optionally `[p]birthdayset timezone`, `[p]birthdayset channel` and `[p]birthdayset allowrole`. For slash commands and context menus run `[p]slash enablecog birthday` and `[p]slash sync`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the IDs of members who currently have the birthday role and when it should be removed. That entry is deleted when the role comes off or on a data deletion request.
